profile.headline: Software Engineer at CoverMyMeds
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at J.P. Morgan Chase.  Current project is moving a Java application to AWS cloud. Interested in everything Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure. 
For personal projects I enjoy using Python, Django, and React to create web applications. IOT and raspberry pi tinkerer.

positions.title: .NET Student
positions.description:
14-week .NET coding bootcamp learning how to develop dynamic web based software systems using the Java programming language and platform. 

Object Oriented Programming: Java, C#, .NET
Web Application Development: HTML, CSS, Javascript, jQuery, Servlets, JSP, Spring Web MVC, Tomcat
Database Programming: JDBC, table design and creation, SQL queries and DML, PostgreSQL, E/R diagrams
Development tools and techniques: Agile, unit testing (JUnit), integration testing, TDD, unix command line navigation, Git, Eclipse
